text: Assumption: Instances of the exception are processed thread-locally — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Instances of the exception are processed thread-locally — is this correct?
norm: instances of the exception are processed thread locally
assumption: Instances of the exception are processed thread-locally.
rationale: The payload contains no information on concurrency, but exceptions in C++ are inherently bound to the executing thread.

original.text: Annahme: Instanzen der Exception dürften thread-lokal verarbeitet werden — trifft das zu?
original.assumption: Instanzen der Exception dürften thread-lokal verarbeitet werden
original.rationale: Der Payload enthält keine Angaben zur Nebenläufigkeit, Exceptions sind in C++ jedoch per se an den ausführenden Thread gebunden.
